name: Internship Scheme Of The Ministry Of Woman And Child Development
department: Ministry of Women and Child Development
benefit: Honorarium: Selected Interns would be paid an honorarium of ₹ 5000/- per month. Certificate: MWCD would award an Internship Certificate to the students on successful completion of the Internship for the said period.
eligibility_rules: Students enrolled in Colleges/ Universities/Academic Institutions or those who passed out recently can apply. For short-term (one month) Internship, students who are doing their undergraduate courses in any subject. The Internship of 2-months is open for those candidates who are holding 2nd class graduation Degree and are enrolled further for Post Graduation Courses in the field of Social Sciences/Social work, Nutrition"ž Child and Gender Studies, Rural Development, Home Science, Economics, Psychology, Sociology, Anthropology, and Political Science are eligible to apply. Students from Management/IITs/IT sectors would also be eligible to apply.

how_to_apply: Mode: Online Interested students/scholars may apply for an internship in the Ministry by downloading the Form given in Annexures I & 2, and forwarding the filled-up form to: intem.wcd@nic.inApplications received after the last date will not be considered.
